text: Demkrates #8423 sang the raising of the temple of the Maker in the agora at the Reef, and the crowd took up the refrain. Sung, it will be remembered longer.

Andrope #5697 walked the poorer streets of Lemnos the night before the Boule sat, and 60 voices changed hands at three obols each.
A fever took Kteniko Aridorides ~19 at 22. Leaves fall early sometimes.
A child for the Gegeneis: Sosides Nichdorides ~1186, born to Nikdoros #3018 and Nikos #4432. It will grow old; its parents will not.
Glaukphon #6243 and Chrysdotos #6638 sowed a child in the Field of Ares: Chthonon Glauchphonides ~1192. A Leaf, born to bone.
